title: DECISION: empty name rejected by GroupFilter.accepts() as defensive guard
description: GroupFilter::accepts() immediately returns false for an empty name string, regardless of patterns. This is documented as a defensive measure because empty group names are invalid in NNTP. Even with a permissive '*' pattern, an empty name is rejected. The test groupfilter_empty_name_always_false verifies this. Without this guard, a bug that passes an empty string as a group name could result in an empty-named group-log entry, which is structurally invalid and hard to diagnose.
